sources.title: Xlm Roberta Large models | The GTM Directory
sources.snippet: XLM-RoBERTa Large is Facebook AI's open-weight multilingual encoder, trained on 2.5TB of filtered CommonCrawl data spanning 100 languages and optimized for cross-lingual discriminative tasks. Its standout trait is strong transfer to both high-resource and low-resource languages without language-specific fine-tuning, with the large variant outperforming the base particularly on long text ...

sources.title: XLM-RoBERTa-Large Multilingual Transformer
sources.snippet: XLM-RoBERTa-Large is a transformer-based multilingual encoder with 550M parameters, pre-trained on 2.5 TB of filtered data using masked language modeling. It features a deep 24-layer architecture and a large 250k subword vocabulary, enabling robust handling of 100 languages and efficient cross-lingual transfer.

sources.title: xlm-roberta-large | Model Catalog | Microsoft Foundry
sources.snippet: xlm-roberta-large is a pre-trained language model available on the Hugging Face Hub. It's specifically designed for the fill-mask task in the transformers library. If you want to learn more about the model's architecture, hyperparameters, limitations, and biases, you can find this information on the model's dedicated Model Card on the Hugging Face Hub .
